notes: Page 1 of the paginated GET /v1beta/models (pageSize<=1000, pageToken) response. The Model resource name is models/{model} (the chat paths take the bare model); thinking is the resource's own 'whether the model supports thinking' boolean — the discovery source for the model row's thinking flag; inputTokenLimit feeds the context window; supportedGenerationMethods gates which rows are chat-routable (the embedding entry pins that filter). nextPageToken drives the pager test.
